title: Studio: the "Create app" dialog's confirm control shares an accessible name with the toolbar button that opens it — a mis-click silently leaves the app uncreated
body:
## What happens

The package workspace toolbar has a button labelled **Create app**, which opens the Create app dialog. The dialog's own confirm control is labelled **`Create (save as draft)`**.

Anything that targets the accessible name **"Create app"** — browser automation, or a user re-clicking the toolbar button — closes/re-opens the dialog **without creating the app**, and **no error is shown**.

The failure only surfaces later, at the app's list route:

> **App not available** — This app is not available yet — it may still be publishing.

That message points at a publishing delay, but the real state is "never created".

## Repro (17.4.0, `objectstack dev`)

1. Open a writable package in App Builder.
2. Click the toolbar **Create app** button; fill the dialog.
3. Click the control whose accessible name is **"Create app"** (rather than `Create (save as draft)`).
4. Navigate to `/_console/apps/<pkg>/<obj>`.

**Actual** — dialog closes, no app is created, no error; the list route shows `App not available … may still be publishing`.
**Expected** — distinct accessible names for the toolbar button vs. the dialog's confirm control; and/or an explicit signal when the dialog is dismissed without creating.

## Why it matters

Two failure modes compound: a **silent no-op**, followed by a **misleading downstream message** that sends you looking for a publishing problem that does not exist. For automation the name collision is the whole bug — there is no way to target the confirm control by name without also matching the toolbar.

## Provenance

Found while producing a product film in `steedos-labs/video-studio` (internal), issue #357, on a read-only clone of `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` @ `c716a2c` with `@objectstack/* 17.4.0`. Reported by the executing session; filed here by the video lane's PM per our cross-repo finding-transfer flow.

**This is a finding, not a claim on anyone's time — filed unassigned.** No duplicate found (nearest existing: #7309, about `confirmText` + `params` opening two dialogs — different mechanism).
